description: This file defines the Settings class for the RomRaider project, a Java-based application for ECU tuning, logging, and reflashing. It contains configuration parameters, constants, and application state variables related to UI, logging, ECU definitions, connection settings, and other project-specific configurations.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Main class encapsulating application configuration, constants, UI preferences, connection and logging settings, and ECU-related configurations for the RomRaider project.
